event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — AI bid returns, oil breaks.
Nov NFP printed 16.5k vs 6.5k forecast and the unemployment rate fell to 4.1% vs 4.2% on Nov 6, validating a risk-on rebound; QQQ +3.54% recovered despite sitting below its 200-day MA. Semis led the squeeze while crude sold off, so this reads as a mechanical AI-pair re-risking into a still-fragile index structure, not fresh trend conviction.

INDICES — VIX 19.9, still elevated above its 19.1 20-day.
SOXX +7.49%, QQQ +3.54%, IWM +3.23%, SPY +2.37%, DIA +2.17%. Large > small by 0.31pp. QQQ remains below its 200-day MA — a live CTA sell trigger. Biggest cross-asset move: USO -3.87% while VIXY -13.41% (vol crush).

VOLUME & BREADTH — SOXX 2.4x is the accumulation tell.
SPY and QQQ vol_ratio come in at 1.19x in the index class, with SOXX 2.4x and IJH 1.8x on the gaining side versus GLD 0.8x and IJR 0.7x fading. Vol up + price up on semis = accumulation; the low volume on defensives and silver suggests short-covering rather than broad commitment. Breadth confirms: 422/78 advancers, 69% above 50-DMA, 62% above 200-DMA, up/down volume 2.96, 48 new highs vs 6 lows — broad, not narrow.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLI Industrials +3.82%, XLK Technology +3.73%, XLY Discretionary +2.92%, XLV Healthcare +1.91%, XLU Utilities +1.53%, XLF Financials +1.45%, XLRE Real Estate +1.45%, XLP Staples +0.90%, XLE Energy +0.52%, XLC Comms +0.00%, XLB Materials +0.00%.
Top industries: UNG +7.81%, SOXX +7.49%; bottom: KWEB -2.29%, USO -3.87%. Flow: XLV +$977mm (98p) and XLF +$816mm (90p) lead inflows; XLC -$710mm (4p) and XLI -$435mm (8p) bleed — XLI's outflow against a +3.82% gain is short-covering, not conviction. Money is rotating into healthcare and financials while concentrated-ETF cash (SPY +$9390mm) powers the index chase. Label: AI hardware leading.

POSITIONING — Complacency under a vol cloud.
SPY and QQQ both show PCR 0.77 (low-ish, leaning complacency) but skew is +14.2%/+14.9% — real put premium being paid. SPY sits above its 751 gamma flip, so hedging dampens rather than amplifies. VIXEQ at 43.9 vs VIX 19.9 is a very wide gap — high single-stock dispersion, a rotation tape; VIX 19.9 is above its 19.1 ma20.

CROSS-ASSET — Diligence the AI trade; oil is the tell.
UNG +7.81% and semis +7.5% rallying together while USO -3.87% and DBC -1.78% fall points to supply-side energy weakness and reallocation into growth/semis rather than a demand story. Dollar -0.55% and gold +1.88% are consistent with risk-on but softening USD. Next FOMC Dec 9: CME FedWatch prices hike 100.0% (hold 0%, cut 0%).

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 51.1, Neutral.
AMD +13.26% on an Oppenheimer upgrade; TER +12.73% on the Omnyx Edge launch; AMAT +11.37% ahead of earnings; NVDA -4.27% on 3.9x volume (distribution against the group). Momentum: UNG leads industries, MSOS -4.01% and USO -3.87% are the laggards. Watch: NVDA (3.9x vol, -4.27% — the laggard to the squeeze), SCHH (3.5x vol, +1.58%, unusual real-estate participation), and SOXX (2.4x vol near the 200-DMA test).
